annotations.title: Repurpose a static ad into variants × formats

description: ONE finished static ad in, VARIANTS × FORMATS out, in one job, as a named file list (<name>_<variant>_<format>_<WxH>.png) with a manifest. The ad's text is read ONCE as the source of truth; each variant's change is made ONCE on the master; every format is derived from that master; every output is text-checked line by line and any line it lost is named (never re-rendered). Variants: {headline}, {language}, {swap:[{from,to}]} (exact words: a price, an offer, a CTA) or {edit} (any change in words), each with an optional {name}; the original is always included. Formats: default 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, or 'everywhere', any canvas or a platform word (snapped to the nearest canvas an image model makes). At most 24 renders. dryRun:true = the exact price, which is what it charges. One resize alone is resize_ad.

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

fixLabel.description: false = no product-label check (default on when the ad shows the brand's saved product)

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

image.description: the ad: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI

name.description: the asset name the files are named after

variants.description: the versions besides the original; a bare string is an edit in words
